name: comp-73
title: Textarea Inset Label
blurb: Label sits inset at the top of the bordered textarea field.
description: A textarea where the label is positioned inside the top of the bordered container as a permanent visual element, creating a unified field appearance.
use_when: Designing compact forms where labels are visually integrated into the field itself.
avoid_when: When label text is lengthy or needs to be hidden from view.
a11y: Label connected via htmlFor, wrapper handles focus-within styling and respects disabled/aria-invalid states.
